limitations: Passing these cases is not a proof of absence of every possible defect.
Browser automation is deferred to CUA/GitHub CI; local shell CI groups exclude browser-launch scripts. Screenshots and QA evidence remain local.
Billing page has no implemented paid subscription purchase/renewal capability.
No real Zalo/SMS/bank transmission, payment provider transaction, physical camera/GPS/contacts or physical low/mid/high device matrix acceptance.
No physical-device P95/60fps guarantee; architecture simulation warnings remain advisory.
Commission is monthly; quarterly/yearly application and unapproved return-money rules remain deliberately gated.
Functions runtime dependency audit has 1 low and 4 moderate findings; no high/critical findings at the configured gate.
APK uses the existing debug QA key and separate acceptance package. Official production signing/Play release is not performed.
Main push validates/builds; it does not activate VPS or deploy Firestore Rules. Production activation remains a separate release.
